summary: This bill establishes a Digital Economy and Cybersecurity Board of Advisors within the National Telecommunications and Information Administration to provide recommendations on cybersecurity best practices and policies for securing information and communications networks.

scores.thoughts: This bill establishes a Digital Economy and Cybersecurity Board of Advisors to provide recommendations on cybersecurity best practices, policies, and promoting security and resilience of information and communications networks. This directly relates to increasing oversight and protection within the tech sector, particularly concerning cybersecurity.
